meaning: A very dark, hard wood.
example: The window frame was made of black ebony.

meaning: A small bed for a baby.
example: The cradle in her room stayed empty.

meaning: The wife of a king, or a woman who rules a country.
example: The new queen was very proud.

meaning: Thinking you are better than other people.
example: She was very proud of her beauty.

meaning: Glass where you can see your face.
example: The magic mirror could not tell a lie.

meaning: A bad feeling when you want what another person has.
example: Her heart was full of envy.

meaning: A man who hunts wild animals.
example: The queen called the huntsman.

meaning: Always loyal and true.
example: You are my most faithful servant.

meaning: A very large place with many trees.
example: He took her into the forest.

meaning: A tool for cutting.
example: He took out his long knife.

meaning: A pig that lives in the forest, not on a farm.
example: A young wild pig ran out of the bushes.

meaning: A part inside the body of a person or animal.
example: He brought the lungs and the liver.

meaning: The parts of the body that you breathe with.
example: The huntsman put the lungs in a bag.

meaning: Not able to find your way.
example: Snow White was lost in the dark forest.

meaning: Whole pieces of bread. One piece is a loaf.
example: There were seven small loaves of bread.

meaning: In stories, a very small man who often works with metal or stone.
example: Seven dwarfs lived in the house.

meaning: To make a hole in the ground.
example: They dig for gold in the mountains.

meaning: A shiny yellow metal that is worth a lot of money.
example: They found small pieces of gold.

meaning: A shiny white-grey metal.
example: The comb was made of silver.

meaning: A light you can carry.
example: The dwarfs lit their seven lamps.

meaning: Clean and neat, with everything in its place.
example: Keep our house in order and you can stay.

meaning: To clean the floor with a broom.
example: She swept the floor every morning.

meaning: A tool with a long handle for cleaning the floor.
example: She took the broom and began to sing.

meaning: Words that tell you about a danger.
example: The dwarfs gave her a warning.

meaning: A long piece of wood that keeps a door shut.
example: She put the bar across the door.

meaning: Wanting to hurt other people.
example: The queen smiled a cruel smile.

meaning: A person who sells things.
example: She looked like an old seller.

meaning: A long, thin piece of colored cloth.
example: She had ribbons, buttons and laces.

meaning: A thin string used to tie clothes tight.
example: The lace was pulled so tight.

meaning: Very close to the body, with no space.
example: The lace was pulled so tight.

meaning: A tool for making your hair neat.
example: She put the comb in her hair.

meaning: Something that can make you very ill or kill you.
example: The poison was on the comb.

meaning: Able to kill.
example: The red half was deadly.

meaning: A hurt place on the body.
example: They looked for a wound.

meaning: A round fruit that can be red, green or yellow.
example: She bit into the apple.

meaning: One of two equal parts.
example: She cut the apple in two halves.

meaning: A box for a dead person.
example: They made a coffin of glass.

meaning: A big black bird.
example: A black raven sat on the glass.

meaning: A bird that hunts at night.
example: The first to come was an owl.

meaning: A white bird, a sign of peace.
example: A white dove stood near her face.

meaning: The son of a king and queen.
example: A young prince came to the house.

meaning: To hit your foot on something and almost fall.
example: A servant tripped on a root.

meaning: The part of a tree under the ground.
example: His foot caught in the roots.

meaning: A party where two people get married.
example: The whole country knew about the wedding.

meaning: A hard grey metal.
example: The shoes were made of iron.

meaning: So hot that it is red.
example: The iron shoes were red hot.

meaning: Kindness to someone who is in your power.
example: Please, have mercy!

meaning: Something bad that happens to a person who did wrong.
example: She must have her punishment.
